selection: The first 24 accepted orbits in the file, in the order LOFTI wrote them. Its samples are drawn independently, so these are a sample of the fit, not a choice among its orbits.
method: LOFTI (Pearce et al. 2020, AJ 894, 115; lofti_gaia 2.0.8) draws orbits from its standard priors, scales and rotates each onto the measured separation and position angle of HD 189733 B from A, and keeps it with the probability of its chi-squared against the measured relative proper motion. Written by tools/objects/binary-orbits/lofti-fit.py with masses 0.807 +/- 0.005 (Lally et al. 2025) and 0.193 +/- 0.020 solar masses (TESS Input Catalog v8.2).
radialVelocity: Not used. The two published relative radial velocities of the pair disagree: -0.72 +/- 1.02 km/s from Bakos et al. (2006) and +3.99 +/- 1.21 km/s from Gaia DR3, which no bound orbit at this separation allows. The fit therefore uses only the Gaia astrometry, which both agree with.
source: Gaia DR3 positions and proper motions of both stars (source_id 1827242816201846144 and 1827242816176111360), fitted with LOFTI; no orbit of this pair is published.
